author: Nerd of the Rings
description:
Today, we dive into the age-old question, would Durin's Bane and Sauron work together?  We look at their histories, how they were used by Morgoth, and their actions after Morgoth's fall!

Hit subscribe and the bell for great Tolkien content every week!
